about: Per-state source table for farm sales (Sig, Oct 27, 2026: every state if possible). Kept by hand. status: live (sales on the land-sales pages), held (in Field Scout and the comp report only), request (a state file exists but on request or for a fee), county (public, county by county, not built), nondisclosure (sale prices not public record; auction results only), unchecked. scripts/build_land_sales.py draws it and counts the live states.

labels.request: State file on request or for a fee
labels.county: Public, county by county; not built yet

note: Checked Oct 27, 2026. Indiana turned on Oct 27 (Sig), Vermont and New Jersey Oct 29. A state marked not public record is from the common lists and our own search; where it says to check, we have not read the state law ourselves yet. Auction results are public where a state keeps prices private, and are next on the list for those states.
